items: Classes & Objects: A class defines state and behaviour; objects are instances of that definition.
Interfaces: A pure contract of method signatures with no implementation.
foreach: The default loop for walking arrays and Traversable objects.
Abstract Classes: A partial base class that forces subclasses to complete certain methods.
Error Handling: Responding to PHP errors and warnings without letting the request die.
Error Patterns: Repeatable strategies: fail fast, wrap and rethrow, aggregate and report.
Factory Pattern: Creating objects through a dedicated creator instead of new at every call site.

8498.title: In this case, I will create a NullUnit class
8498.code:
<?php
class NullUnit extends Unit
{
    public function bombardStrength(): int
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public function getHealth(): int
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public function getDepth(): int
    {
        return 0;
    }
}
8498.explanation: The Null Object pattern allows us to delegate the doing of nothing to a class of an expected type. In this case, I will create a NullUnit class.
